name: Bogota
why: Capital and main air hub; flights to every Colombian node plus Panama, Central America and Bolivia

name: Medellin
why: Most popular backpacker city; second air hub (JMC airport 45 min out, Olaya Herrera EOH for Clic/Satena)

name: Cali
why: Salsa capital in the south; air link to Caribbean coast and San Andres

name: Cartagena
why: Walled colonial city, top Caribbean destination and Panama flight/boat gateway

name: Santa Marta
why: Gateway to Tayrona, Minca, Palomino and the Sierra Nevada

name: Pereira
why: Coffee region air and bus hub for Salento, Manizales and Cocora

name: San Andres
why: Caribbean island, direct flights from most Colombian cities and Panama

name: Providencia
why: Quiet island reached only by Satena flight or ferry from San Andres

name: Salento (Valle de Cocora)
why: Coffee-region village and gateway to Valle de Cocora wax palms

name: Manizales
why: Coffee-region city near Los Nevados; La Nubia airport has Clic flights

name: Guatape
why: Lake town and El Penol rock, standard Medellin day trip (about 2 h)

name: Tayrona National Park
why: Top Caribbean beach park, entrances El Zaino, Calabazo, Palangana, Bahia Concha

name: Palomino
why: Backpacker beach town with river tubing, on the coast road east of Tayrona

name: Minca
why: Cloud-forest village above Santa Marta, hostels and coffee farms

name: Barranquilla
why: Transfer city between Cartagena and Santa Marta, airport with Avianca/LATAM/Wingo/JetSmart

name: San Gil (and Barichara)
why: Adventure sports capital of Santander, base for Barichara and Chicamocha

name: Villa de Leyva
why: Colonial town 3-4 h from Bogota

name: Necocli
why: Gulf of Uraba port where boats leave for Capurgana (main route toward Panama)

name: Capurgana
why: Car-free Caribbean beach town near the Panama border (airstrip CPB charters)

name: Sapzurro
why: Bay village 10-15 min by boat from Capurgana; trail up to the La Miel border post

name: Puerto Obaldia
why: Panamanian border town with immigration; Air Panama flights to Panama City

name: Panama City
why: Copa hub; nearest big neighbour region to Colombia by air

name: San Salvador
why: Central America link from Bogota (Avianca nonstop)

name: San Jose (Costa Rica)
why: Central America link from Bogota and Cartagena (Avianca Costa Rica, Copa)

name: La Paz
why: Bolivia link: Avianca nonstop from Bogota

name: Santa Cruz de la Sierra
why: Bolivia link: Avianca nonstop from Bogota, Copa from Panama
